items.title_orig: Chelsea Wolfe Details New Album 'The Dark'
items.article_text:
The follow-up to 2024's 'She Reaches Out to She Reaches Out to She' arrives in August

BY Megan LaPierrePublished Jul 21, 2026

Chelsea Wolfe — the Sacramento, CA-born singer-songwriter who has spent the last two decades combining elements of gothic rock, doom metal and folk — has announced her forthcoming ninth studio album, previewed today by new single "Cold."

The follow-up to 2024's She Reaches Out to She Reaches Out to She, The Dark is due August 21 via Loma Vista Recordings. Produced with longtime collaborator Ben Chisholm and new co-writer Jennifer Decilveo, the 10-track collection sees Wolfe stripping down her sound "to give deserved space to what would become the finest songwriting of her storied career," according to a press release.

The Dark features contributions from Robin Finck (Nine Inch Nails), Matt Chamberlain (Pearl Jam), Troy Van Leeuwen (Queens of the Stone Age), Stella Mozgawa (Warpaint) and Justin Meldal-Johnsen (Nine Inch Nails, St. Vincent). Preview Wolfe's latest material by checking out the video for her new single and album opener "Cold," a icily strummed ballad that crescendos into a piano-driven dirge, below, where you'll also find the full tracklist details.
